components.label: Clients
components.blurb: Where requests start. Its region is where your users are.

components.label: CDN
components.blurb: Answers cacheable reads at an edge location near users.

components.label: Load balancer
components.blurb: Spreads requests across the servers behind it.

components.label: API gateway
components.blurb: Auth, rate limits and routing in front of your services.

components.label: App server
components.blurb: Runs your request handlers. Scale out with replicas.

components.label: Worker
components.blurb: Pulls jobs from a queue and processes them in the background.

components.label: Cache
components.blurb: In-memory store for hot reads. Misses fall through to the database.

components.label: Database
components.blurb: Primary database. Takes every write and any reads sent to it.

components.label: Read replica
components.blurb: Read-only copy of the primary. Takes reads and replays every write.

components.label: Queue
components.blurb: Accepts work now and hands it to workers at their own pace.

components.label: Object storage
components.blurb: Files and media, S3-style. A share of reads fetch from it.

components.label: Third-party API
components.blurb: A service you call but do not run, such as payments or email.
